page_title: STU 5-0 FRE | Stuttgart v Freiburg 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' The attendance is 54300.
90' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
90' 1:1 – these are the offside statistics for both sides in this match.
86' Felix Brych shows a yellow card to Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) for a tough tackle.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Freiburg comes to nothing.
80' Substitution. Serhou Guirassy makes way for Jovan Milosevic (VfB Stuttgart).
80' Substitution. Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) has come on for Chris Fuhrich.
75' 5 - 0 Goal! Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) slotted the ball past the goalkeeper!
73' Christian Streich has decided to make a change. Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) replaces Maximilian Eggestein.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vincenzo Grifo leaves the pitch and Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) comes on.
71' The number of shots on goal at present is 5:4.
68' Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
67' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Felix Brych blows for a foul.
64' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Silas is replaced by Roberto Massimo (VfB Stuttgart).
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Woo-Yeong Jeong will be replaced by Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart).
62' 4 - 0 Goal! Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 4:0.
59' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) makes a rough challenge and Felix Brych blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) gets to the ball from the resulting corner kick and attempts to curl it past the keeper. His wild shot sails wide of the goal.
57' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
53' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 4:4.
53' Substitution. Pascal Stenzel makes his way off the pitch and Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) comes on as his replacement.
51' Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
51' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
50' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Felix Brych interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Christian Streich probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg). He is replaced by Kenneth Schmidt.
46' Half-time substitution. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) will not participate anymore and Maximilian Philipp is coming on.
46' Christian Streich makes a half-time substitution. Ritsu Doan comes on in place of Roland Sallai (Freiburg).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.

43' Wonder save! Roland Sallai (Freiburg) picked up the ball and hit a beautiful curling shot from the edge of the box. Alexander Nubel saw it late but somehow got his fingers to the ball to keep it out.
40' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

39' The game is interrupted. Roland Sallai (Freiburg) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Stuttgart in a dangerous position.
38' Felix Brych shows the yellow card to Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) for a heavy challenge.
38' A player from Stuttgart commits a rough challenge. Felix Brych blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
36' Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Noah Atubolu acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save!
35' Stuttgart exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
34' The resulting set piece from Freiburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

34' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Alexander Nubel sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner. The ball goes out of play. Freiburg are awarded a corner kick.
33' Ball possession – 45:55.
31' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg). Felix Brych saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
31' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
29' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) gets on the end of the resulting free kick, but he produces a poor shot which goes well wide of the right post!
27' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Felix Brych no option but to blow his whistle.
26' Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Freiburg concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
23' The current number of shots on goal is 3:2.
19' 3 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) was set free in the area by Hiroki Ito and fired past Noah Atubolu. 3:0.
17' 2 - 0 Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
14' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is caught offside!
12' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

8' 1 - 0 Goal! Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Noah Atubolu had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.
7' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
6' Dangerous play by Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart). Felix Brych blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Freiburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
3' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) climbs higher than the defenders inside the box and plants a towering header against the right post. What a great chance!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Freiburg will have the kick-off.
Felix Brych will officiate today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
